::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/usages"}
#docs
Cursor-paginated, oldest first by `created_at` unless sorted. Scope with `subscription`, `item` (si_…) or `price`; filter with `usage_date[op]`, `created_at[op]`, `invoiced[is]=true|false` and `invoice[op]`. `invoice` is the finalized invoice that rated the record's window — null until then (a `pending` invoice does not count: it re-aggregates at close).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription` | `string` | no | Only usage on this subscription (sub_…). |
| `item` | `string` | no | Only usage on this subscription item (si_…). |
| `price` | `string` | no | Only usage for this price (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `usage_date[after]` | `string` | no | Any date operator: usage_date[before\|after\|on\|between\|…] |
| `invoiced[is]` | `string` | no | Only usage that is already invoiced (`true`) or not yet invoiced (`false`). |
| `invoice[is]` | `string` | no | Any text operator on the rating invoice's id |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of rows to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_record`. One of `usage_record`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The usage record id. |
| `data.subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `data.item` | `string` | The subscription item id. Null after the item was removed from the subscription. The record stays. |
| `data.price` | `string` | The metered price id. Null only if the price was deleted. |
| `data.quantity` | `integer` | The quantity used. |
| `data.unique_key` | `string` | Your own key for the event. Repeats with the same key do nothing. |
| `data.operation` | `string` | add, or remove for a unique key that left. |
| `data.timestamp` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the usage happened. |
| `data.note` | `string` | A note on the event. |
| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice that billed the usage, or null if not billed. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the record was created. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if more items follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque cursor; pass it as `starting_after` to read the next page. |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Count of the filtered set. First page only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of usage_record |
| `400` | Unknown query parameter or bad filter value |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usages?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
